purpose: Adapt the released V2 route to real field timing without mutating the qualified V2 release while the visit is in progress.
operating_rules: Prefer real field conditions over the original route.
Never chase a skipped scene by creating a detour.
Reuse already-qualified V1/V2 scenes when they naturally lie on the revised path.
Logistics legs may be intentional silence.
Update this field plan at each material checkpoint while the visit is in progress.

checkpoints.label: NH micro-loop
checkpoints.route_intent: Short loop around NH / old Plaza de Armas station, then immediate return to NH.
checkpoints.abort_rule: At 10:34 local, turn back to NH regardless of remaining curiosity.

checkpoints.label: Recover bags and taxi
checkpoints.route_intent: NH -> Pje. de Vila by taxi/VTC.

checkpoints.label: Pje de Vila bag drop
checkpoints.route_intent: Deposit bags immediately when access opens.

checkpoints.label: Pje de Vila -> Cathedral sector
checkpoints.route_intent: Direct walking line toward Catedral de Sevilla. One micro-scene is allowed only if it lies naturally on the route.
checkpoints.skip_rule: If bags are not deposited by 11:10, skip all interpretation and walk directly to the Cathedral sector.

checkpoints.label: Cathedral / Giralda
checkpoints.route_intent: Be in the Cathedral sector by about 11:45 for the 12:10 booking.

checkpoints.label: Post-Cathedral recovery
checkpoints.route_intent: Lunch/rest first; exact shape decided from actual Cathedral exit time.

deferred_from_original_friday.reason: Late field start and 11:00 accommodation access make the original Triana/Arenal morning loop incompatible with the 12:10 Cathedral booking.
deferred_from_original_friday.note: SEV2-FRI-AM-02 may still be used opportunistically during the NH micro-loop only if the real clock permits.

next_live_decision.trigger: User reaches the old Plaza de Armas station / completes first micro-step.
next_live_decision.decision: Either add a very short river glance or turn directly back to NH based on actual time.
